GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 800.217 (8 Oct 46) GD
(SCAPIN - 1256)
APO 500
8 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Change of Vessels for Whaling Operation.
1. Reference is made to Central Liaison Office Letter number 5051 (CM) of 1 October 1946. The Taiho Maru cannot be made available for the scheduled whaling operation.
2. Permission is granted to use the Showa Maru number ten in place of the Takunan Maru number eight.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
